citation: Naimi F, et al. Antilipolytic insulin sensitivity indices measured during an oral glucose challenge: associations with insulin-glucose clamp-derived indices. Endocrinol Metab 2025;40:561-.
protocol: 75 g OGTT sampled every 10 min from -20 to 120 min (glucose, insulin, NEFA) plus a two-step euglycaemic-hyperinsulinaemic clamp: 10 mU/m2/min for 120 min, then 40 mU/m2/min for 2 h; M over the last 20 min.
population: 15 healthy non-PCOS women (age 28.5 +/- 5.9, BMI 22.7 +/- 2.3) printed separately from 14 women with PCOS; total 29.

reports.marker: glucose and insulin at 120 min, AUC glucose, insulin, NEFA (OGTT)

note: Gives both an OGTT with NEFA and a two-step clamp in the same healthy women, a useful FFA link; read only the non-PCOS column. Insulin and AUCs are medians with IQR, glucose and M mean +/- SD; clamp-time NEFA values are mainly in figures.
